svg.text: Priority 1 accepted calibration · Administrative Percussion + low acoustic furniture
ONE STAFFED SEAT = ONE 1×1 CONVERSION STATION
The Keypunch Console is the per-seat product. Rows of consoles supersede the row-form Keypunch Bank; the Tabulating
Machine remains the small shared collector. Baffles protect seats without becoming room walls.
cream shoulders · dark mechanism · green plinth

Integrated desk-height punch station: card hopper,
mechanical punch drum, dense key deck, and physical
output slot. No screen or readout.

field, rounded frame, posts, and visible feet say
